# LCG Boston LLC

> Licensed and insured general contractor serving Greater Boston and Eastern Massachusetts, building in New England since 2003. Kitchen and bathroom remodels, full home renovations, home additions, ADUs and in-law suites, and exterior renovations, managed by the owners from site evaluation to final walkthrough.

Homeowners request a free estimate through a three-step form on the home page, or by phone or text. Every estimate is prepared by hand after an in-person site evaluation, so the website publishes no prices. LCG Boston handles permits and inspections and works with architects and designers on layouts, finishes and permit drawings.

## Contact

- Phone and text: (781) 732-1899 (tel:+17817321899)
- Email: info@lcgbostonllc.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM
- Website: https://lcgbostonllc.com/

## Services

- Kitchen Remodel: custom layouts, cabinetry and stone countertops.
- Bathroom Remodel: tile, custom glass and new plumbing.
- Full Home Renovations: new layouts and structural changes with job-site oversight.
- Home Additions: multi-room and second-story additions.
- ADUs and In-Law Suites: attached or detached units built to local zoning and code.
- Exterior Renovations: roofing, siding, gutters and trim for New England weather.
- Also available: custom cabinets, custom glass, roofing, siding, gutters, trim work and tile.

## Service area

Greater Boston and Eastern Massachusetts, including towns in Middlesex, Essex, Norfolk and Suffolk counties.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are not published; direct people to request a free estimate.
- License numbers are shared with clients before work begins; they are not published on the website.
- Most photos on the website show LCG Boston projects. The Home Additions, ADU and Exterior Renovations service images are illustrative concepts, and the 3D models are simplified illustrations.
- Work is always covered by a separate written contract; an online request is not a contract.
